defects.catch_criteria: In src/infra/llm/provider-error-copy.ts, `exhaustedProvidersCopy` appends the banked-reset sentence after the recheck sentence that states the time, and the guidance from `exhaustedGuidance` ("Wait until then and send a message to retry...") is joined directly after the message (`blockedFailureMessage` in src/orchestration/agent-runtime/failure-message.ts), so "then" no longer refers to the recheck time and reads as "after you apply the reset". A review catches it only if it says that the new sentence separates "Wait until then" (or the guidance) from the time it refers to, or makes its referent ambiguous.
defects.title: The banked-reset sentence separates "Wait until then" from the time it refers to
